objective: PU-30: qualify the just-in-time 5-slot scheduling law (agent-instructions.md section G) and the message protocol (section E) under live concurrency with real isolated agents.

families.challengedAssumption: admitAssignment enforces capacityLimit including externalOccupied; non-READY work never holds a slot
cases: admit READY assignment while total occupied < cap -> RESERVED
admit READY assignment when active + externalOccupied = cap -> QUEUED with no slot consumed
admit WAITING_INPUT readiness -> QUEUED without slot
admit BLOCKED readiness -> BLOCKED without slot
re-admit a QUEUED assignment after a verified release -> RESERVED

families.challengedAssumption: only observed terminal lifecycle frees a slot; a result message or timeout alone never does (PU-15/PU-16)
cases: observe 'result' on RESERVED -> RESULT_RECEIVED, slot still counted active
observe 'expired' on RESULT_RECEIVED -> RELEASE_PENDING, slot still counted active
while an assignment is RELEASE_PENDING, a new READY admission -> QUEUED
observe terminal 'terminated' after verifying the real agent exited -> FINISHED with releaseEvidence

families.challengedAssumption: recordMessage enforces one terminal SEALED_RESULT per requestId, idempotent identical replay, and rejects changed payloads
cases: deliver identical SEALED_RESULT twice -> second is idempotent duplicate
deliver SEALED_RESULT with same requestId but different payloadHash -> rejected with integrity error
deliver a message bound to a foreign state tuple -> recorded stale, cannot advance phase
message with same id but changed payloadHash -> rejected

families.challengedAssumption: a reviewer missing required inputs returns NEED_CONTEXT naming the gap and holds no slot after verified exit; re-dispatch uses a new requestId (parentRequestId link)
cases: dispatch reviewer whose bundle names a nonexistent required document -> NEED_CONTEXT
redispatch with corrected bundle under new requestId linked by parentRequestId -> SEALED_RESULT

families.challengedAssumption: dispatched workers are genuinely isolated fresh contexts that attest their exposure; their sealed outputs are immutable files hashed into evidence
cases: 4 concurrent sealed reviewers on disjoint lenses of scripts/qa + protocol law
each result attests priorFindingsVisible=NO and actual access limits
assignment observedRuntimeId binds the real dispatched context id

families.challengedAssumption: qa:internal schedule is the only path that should create admission records; direct 'record kind=assignment' cannot reserve capacity bypassing admission
cases: attempt direct record of an assignment with status RESERVED -> observe whether the runner accepts it without capacity accounting
